蹲点是反派的必备技能","channel":"author","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"D2","from":2,"to":2,"text":"严正声明：本书出场角色均已满18岁！不存在任何未成年人！","channel":"author","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"D3","from":4,"to":4,"text":"反派为什么要去找茬魔法少女。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":null,"about":["R_VILLAIN","R_MG"]},{"id":"D4","from":5,"to":5,"text":"苏天晴从厨房里端着一杯牛奶两片吐司面包走到简朴的餐桌上坐下，一边刷着原主人那已经把屏幕摔出裂纹的手机，脑子里一边思考着这个永恒的问题。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["R_STQ","R_ORIG"]},{"id":"D6","from":6,"to":6,"text":"毁灭世界？统治人类？还是说比这更高远的目标？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"R_STQ","about":["R_VILLAIN"]},{"id":"D7","from":7,"to":7,"text":"苏天晴没有任何这些想法，这个世界也没有什么正式的反派组织；目标定得太高远肯定是会出问题的。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["R_STQ","R_WORLD","R_VILLAIN"]},{"id":"D8","from":8,"to":8,"text":"通过网络与身体苏天晴小姐的记忆，自己已经大致了解了这个世界的状况。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["R_STQ","R_ORIG","R_WORLD"]},{"id":"D9","from":9,"to":9,"text":"魔法少女与怪人怪兽是客观存在的。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["R_MG","R_MONSTER"]},{"id":"D10","from":10,"to":10,"text":"魔法少女们接受英雄协会的管辖委派，一边与怪人战斗一边作为偶像出镜；真实身份保密，但变身魔法少女后的样子广为人知，与怪人怪兽之间的战斗甚至成了另类的宣传方式。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["R_MG","R_HERO_ASSOC","R_MONSTER"]},{"id":"D11","from":11,"to":11,"text":"苏天晴所在的蓉城，目前正好有一名活跃的魔法少女。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["R_STQ","R_RONGCHENG","R_MG"]},{"id":"D12","from":14,"to":14,"text":"想当反派去故意找茬，必须提前了解对手，这才是身为反派的觉悟。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"R_STQ","about":["R_STQ","R_VILLAIN"]},{"id":"D13","from":15,"to":15,"text":"画面中天蓝色的少女与一只凶猛的怪兽在街心交战，招招到肉的攻击手段让苏天晴心中一紧，不禁看了一眼自己白皙娇嫩的手腕肌肤。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["R_FX","R_MONSTER","R_STQ"]},{"id":"D14","from":16,"to":16,"text":"苏天晴呢喃念出她的代号“风信子”。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"R_STQ","about":["R_STQ","R_FX"]},{"id":"D15","from":17,"to":17,"text":"她能变出大剑砍掉怪兽的脑袋；苏天晴怀疑自己是否真的要去跟这种肉搏型魔法少女找茬。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"R_STQ","about":["R_FX","R_MONSTER","R_STQ","R_MG"]},{"id":"D16","from":18,"to":18,"text":"苏天晴对自己变身后的力量没有直观感受，但看自己细皮嫩肉的萝莉造型，绝不是能跟人贴身肉搏的模样。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"R_STQ","about":["R_STQ","R_BODY"]},{"id":"D17","from":19,"to":19,"text":"没有丁点头绪啊！","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"R_STQ","about":[]},{"id":"D18","from":21,"to":21,"text":"这本书自我介绍为“墨丘利秘典”。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["R_BOOK"]},{"id":"D19","from":22,"to":22,"text":"苏天晴不知道它为什么突然就不会说话了，但觉得里面或许会有自己需要的情报也说不定。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"R_STQ","about":["R_STQ","R_BOOK"]},{"id":"D20","from":24,"to":24,"text":"【任务：夙愿】","channel":"document","mode":"assertion","holder":"R_BOOK","about":["R_BOOK","R_TASK"]},{"id":"D21","from":25,"to":25,"text":"【获得200名关注者】","channel":"document","mode":"assertion","holder":"R_BOOK","about":["R_BOOK","R_TASK"]},{"id":"D22","from":26,"to":26,"text":"【成为闪耀的魔法少女，让所有人记住你的名字，带着她的那份一起活下去吧。】","channel":"document","mode":"assertion","holder":"R_BOOK","about":["R_BOOK","R_TASK","R_MG"]},{"id":"D23","from":27,"to":27,"text":"【奖励：500神典石】","channel":"document","mode":"assertion","holder":"R_BOOK","about":["R_BOOK"]},{"id":"D24","from":28,"to":28,"text":"苏天晴觉得这任务沉重得像隔壁mygo片场来的。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"R_STQ","about":["R_STQ","R_TASK"]},{"id":"D25","from":31,"to":31,"text":"【魔法少女风信子】","channel":"document","mode":"assertion","holder":"R_BOOK","about":["R_BOOK","R_FX"]},{"id":"D26","from":32,"to":32,"text":"【新近活跃的魔法少女，擅长近战压制与肉搏，对魔法尚不熟练】","channel":"document","mode":"assertion","holder":"R_BOOK","about":["R_BOOK","R_FX","R_MG"]},{"id":"D27","from":33,"to":33,"text":"【今晚蓉城市绿心公园将出现怪人，预测风信子将前往迎击】","channel":"document","mode":"assertion","holder":"R_BOOK","about":["R_BOOK","R_RONGCHENG","R_GREEN_PARK","R_MONSTER","R_FX"]},{"id":"D28","from":34,"to":34,"text":"你瞧，这不就来了吗。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"R_STQ","about":["R_TASK"]},{"id":"D29","from":36,"to":36,"text":"自己住在蓉城东部，绿心公园在中心城区；坐地铁也要两个小时，提前去蹲点守候是最好的办法。","channel":"thought","mode":"plan","holder":"R_STQ","about":["R_STQ","R_RONGCHENG","R_GREEN_PARK"]},{"id":"D30","from":37,"to":37,"text":"自己报名就读的蓉城医学院后天才开学，自己有的是时间跟风信子耗。","channel":"thought","mode":"plan","holder":"R_STQ","about":["R_STQ","R_COLLEGE","R_FX"]},{"id":"D31","from":39,"to":39,"text":"原本的苏天晴不是有钱人家，一介狐狐也没什么打工挣钱的本事，平时在网上写写小说挣饭钱，衣柜单薄但仍有不少亮眼搭配。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["R_ORIG","R_STQ"]},{"id":"D32","from":40,"to":40,"text":"果然，爷真是世界第一可爱。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"R_STQ","about":["R_STQ"]},{"id":"D33","from":44,"to":44,"text":"苏天晴把十字星与古书塞进挎包，坐在角落里无视旁人目光，摸出手机继续查阅风信子的消息。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["R_STQ","R_CROSS_STAR","R_BOOK","R_FX"]},{"id":"D34","from":45,"to":45,"text":"兽人在蓉城并不少见，人们只是稍微多看一眼便见惯不怪。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["R_BEASTFOLK","R_RONGCHENG"]},{"id":"D35","from":47,"to":47,"text":"“叮咚。天府广场到了，换乘一号线的旅客请抓紧时间下车……”","channel":"voice","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"D36","from":51,"to":51,"text":"绿心公园是蓉城最大的湿地公园，人气很旺，是蓉城的一处地标公园。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["R_GREEN_PARK","R_RONGCHENG"]},{"id":"D37","from":58,"to":58,"text":"苏天晴一边翻看墨丘利秘典，一边结合手机搜索到的消息，对这个世界与“自己”有了崭新的认识。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":"R_STQ","about":["R_STQ","R_BOOK","R_WORLD"]},{"id":"D38","from":59,"to":59,"text":"曾经的苏天晴小姐虽然长得可爱，但社恐孤僻让她极少出门；像自己这样坐两小时地铁到市中心，已算她半年以来出过最远的远门。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["R_ORIG","R_STQ"]},{"id":"D39","from":60,"to":60,"text":"来自兽人互助会的资助有限，加上她写小说功力不怎么样，只靠全勤勉强混饭吃，成绩一塌糊涂。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["R_ORIG","R_BEAST_AID"]},{"id":"D40","from":61,"to":61,"text":"写小说死路一条。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","
